clue.text: The Times, Le Monde, Die Welt, El Pais and La Stampa will be sure to include it

definitions.text: The Times, Le Monde, Die Welt, El Pais and La Stampa will be sure to include it

parts.words: The Times, Le Monde, Die Welt, El Pais and La Stampa will be sure to include it
parts.note: each newspaper title opens with the word for 'the' in its own language: The, Le, Die, El, La

explanation.surface: A list of great European newspapers that are bound to carry some particular story.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'it' every paper is sure to include is not a news item but the first word of its own name.
explanation.definitionFit: The, le, die, el and la are each the grammatical determiner of definiteness in English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

clue.text: "Pioneer" of space travel making messenger stick with study — swell!

parts.note: a gene carries hereditary information, so it acts as a biological messenger
a rod is a stick
a den is a private study or workroom
'the berries' is old American slang for something excellent, as is 'swell!'

explanation.surface: An exclamation of delight at someone combining a courier's pole with some study.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks round 'Pioneer' warn that the space travel is fiction: he created the Star Trek television series.
explanation.definitionFit: He created Star Trek, whose crews boldly went where no one had gone before, a fictional trailblazer of interstellar voyaging.

clue.text: Route to maltreatment? No energy

indicators.note: 'no' tells us the following item, energy, is to be removed from the phrase

parts.note: the route to treating someone badly is, whimsically, 'the rough way'
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A question asking which road leads to abuse, with the energy gone.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase meant is THE ROUGH WAY; dropping the E of THE leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A throughway is an expressway or major road, so it is a route for traffic.

clue.text: The game's over — ready to meet one's maker

definitions.meaning: a phrase for things having come to an end, as when a light or life is extinguished
about to die, which this slang phrase means

explanation.definitionFit: It is British slang for dying, like a candle snuffed out, and so also for anything finished.

clue.text: The chorusmaster's response from the choir

definitions.text: The chorusmaster's response from the choir

indicators.note: from tells us the reply comes out of the opening words, taken from within them

explanation.surface: How a choir replies to its leader's instruction.
explanation.walkthrough: The reply is lurking in 'The chorus', across the join of the first two words, and the whole clue describes it too: a choir repeating its master's line.
explanation.definitionFit: A repetition of a sound sent back to its source is what this word means, as a choir repeats its leader.

clue.text: Many left search in Year One — cracking game!

indicators.note: the whole inner group breaks into the word for many, splitting it open

parts.note: tons means a great many
went means left, departed

indicators.note: the search is placed inside the letters for Year and One

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a quest is a search

explanation.surface: Plenty of people abandoned a search in their first year of an exciting game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Many' looks like the start of the definition, but it supplies the outer word that everything else cracks open.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a parlour guessing game where players identify an object by asking up to that number of yes-or-no queries.

clue.text: Supporter does, as fan letter paid off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters are thrown off course and reassembled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A fan letter has been paid for and dispatched, with a supporter behaving the same way.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'Supporter' is a bra, and the answer was a famous advertising slogan for one.
explanation.definitionFit: A bra is a supporter, and this was the advertised claim of what one such garment does.

clue.text: Lawrence told people about Henry's fundraiser

parts.note: T E Lawrence, Lawrence of Arabia, gives his initials

indicators.note: the phrase for telling goes about the letter for Henry

parts.note: to let on is to tell people a secret
H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: Lawrence spread news of a charity event run by Henry.
explanation.definitionFit: A long televised charity broadcast appealing for donations is a fundraiser.

clue.text: Shell out for primitive deal?

parts.note: read as a shell handed over to settle a deal in a primitive economy, a sea shell used as money

explanation.surface: Paying up for a crude bargain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shell out' looks like 'pay'; here it is a real shell paid out, as these were used as currency.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a glossy sea snail shell long used as money in Africa and Asia.

clue.text: Old writer, one working as decorator in firm

indicators.note: the decorator goes inside the abbreviation for the firm

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
an icer decorates cakes with icing

explanation.surface: An elderly author takes a job decorating for a company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decorator' suggests painting rooms; the decorating here is of cakes.
explanation.definitionFit: Cicero was a Roman orator and prolific author of speeches, letters and philosophy.

clue.text: Ranger's friend turns into the opposite, making low comment

indicators.note: the reversed name goes into the word for the opposite

parts.note: the opposite of a friend is a foe

indicators.note: turns means the companion's name is read backwards

parts.note: Tonto is the companion of the Lone Ranger in the Western serials

explanation.surface: A ranger's companion becomes his enemy, prompting a disparaging remark.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a note printed at the bottom of a page, so a comment placed low down.

clue.text: Ex's allowance not providing for any car

indicators.note: the letters of 'any' are left out, not provided for, scattered through the word

parts.note: alimony is the maintenance paid to a former spouse

explanation.surface: Ex's maintenance won't stretch to any car.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters A, N and Y removed are not together but in order through the word.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a short form for limousine, a luxurious chauffeured car.

clue.text: Contradiction — Georgia, proverbially?

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Georgia
a proverb is a saying, so proverbially means as it goes in saying

explanation.surface: A question whether Georgia is known for some contradiction in its proverbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Gainsaying is denial or contradiction of what someone has said.

clue.text: With current female covered by separate condition

indicators.note: the three short items sit inside, covered by, the word for separate

parts.note: to sever is to separate
an amp is a unit of electric current

explanation.surface: A woman on a current is protected by a separate condition, as if in some legal agreement.
explanation.definitionFit: It is an infectious viral disease of horses, also an old name for malaria, so a medical condition.

clue.text: This spare tyre would be one!

definitions.text: This spare tyre would be one!

parts.words: This spare tyre would be one!
parts.note: a tyre that has been deflated, its air let out, and so a disappointment when needed

explanation.surface: An exclamation about a disappointing spare tyre.
explanation.walkthrough: A flat spare is literally deflated and figuratively a disappointment.
explanation.definitionFit: A disappointment is called this, and a flat spare tyre is exactly that when you need it.

clue.text: Clearer of conscience, Shed pens of himself

indicators.note: pens means encloses, as a farmer pens sheep

parts.note: cast means shed, as a snake casts its skin
sui is Latin for of himself

explanation.surface: Someone easing his conscience in a shed writes about himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shed' looks like a building and 'pens' like writing instruments; they are a verb meaning cast and a verb meaning encloses.
explanation.definitionFit: A casuist resolves cases of conscience by subtle reasoning, so clears moral doubts.

clue.text: Liqueur that is understood to infuse information-bearer upwards

indicators.note: to infuse means to steep inside, so the phrase goes into the reversed letters
in a down clue, upwards means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: DNA carries genetic information
'I see' is said when something is understood

explanation.surface: A liqueur steeped in some data-carrying medium that rises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that is' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: It flavours anisette and similar spirits and, by extension, names the liqueur itself.

clue.text: Make Violet put back ginger biscuit

parts.note: a make is a brand

indicators.note: put back means the flower's name is read backwards

parts.note: the pansy is a kind of violet

explanation.surface: Instructions to get Violet to return a ginger biscuit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Violet' looks like a girl's name; it is the plant family of the pansy.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a thin rolled crisp biscuit flavoured with ginger.

clue.text: August following in short tribal division

definitions.meaning: a clan or branch of a family, especially in Ireland

explanation.definitionFit: It is the abbreviation of the ninth month and also a word for a clan or division of a tribe.

clue.text: Inspirational work almost cutting supplies

indicators.note: the word for almost cuts into the word for supplies

parts.note: to fit out is to supply, so fits means supplies
near means almost

explanation.surface: Inspired work almost cut short by supplies running low.
explanation.definitionFit: Painting, sculpture and music are creative pursuits from inspiration, so inspired work.

clue.text: Hotel announced legal documentation

indicators.note: announced signals the word is heard rather than read

parts.note: writs are formal legal documents

explanation.surface: A hotel declares its legal papers.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ritz is a famous luxury hotel in London and elsewhere.

clue.text: One fled French regime after Revolution

indicators.note: after a revolution things are overturned and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone escaped the French regime after the Revolution.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's French Revolution is literal for the definition, as the word first named royalists who fled it.
explanation.definitionFit: An emigre is an exile, originally a French royalist who fled the Revolution.

clue.text: Bordeaux's patron saint with her object of patronage? Not half

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', so the definition is Bordeaux itself

parts.note: St Clare of Assisi is the patron saint of television

indicators.note: only half the abbreviation is kept, the other letter dropped

parts.note: TV, television, is what St Clare is patron of

explanation.surface: Bordeaux's patron saint with whatever she protects, but not half of it.
explanation.walkthrough: Bordeaux suggests the city, but it is the wine; St Clare's patronage of TV comes from her reportedly seeing Mass on her wall when too ill to attend.
explanation.definitionFit: Claret is the British name for red wine from the Bordeaux region.

clue.text: Threesome accepted by topless goddess produces a great time!

indicators.note: the threesome is taken inside the shortened word
topless means the first letter is cut off

parts.note: a goddess is a deity
a tern is a set of three

explanation.surface: A threesome welcomed by a topless goddess has a wonderful time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topless' takes D from DEITY to leave EITY.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternity is endless duration, so the greatest possible span of time.
